_about: Sandy And Danny - Hebrew lexicon for TTS (ElevenLabs eleven_v4). 'tts' = the pointed spelling sent to TTS. Subtitles always use the plain spelling. Add every new character here BEFORE its first episode.
_prefix_rule: A name with a prefix letter (לדובי, בשוקו, ומוצי...) must be fully pointed for TTS, e.g. לְדוּבִּי - the unpointed form was read 'la-Duvi' in EP1.

חדשה.why: EP1: stress landed on the wrong syllable; stress is on -SHA

הריח.why: EP1: tense came out wrong; point the verb in the tense you mean

מתקתק.why: EP2: means a clock ticking (or 'sweetish'); a chick inside an egg KNOCKS - use 'דופק' / 'מקיש'

לך.why: TTS reads unpointed 2nd person as feminine by default - point by the listener's gender

_person_rule: Do not mix an imperative to 'you' (סרקו) with a 'we' verb (ונצבע) in one sentence. 'בואו + נ...' is correct and is NOT flagged.
